text: 'Stop the churn' isn't a requirement yet, it's an intention. This lesson turns it into one precise number everyone agrees on.
A risk flag the week before renewal helps nobody. Tom Bellamy needs real runway, so the window has to be long enough to actually act on.
The agreed target: as of a snapshot date called OBSERVATION_DATE, will this account churn sometime in the next 90 days? That exact definition drives everything built later.
Before trusting it, we read real rows out of dbo.Accounts by hand, and check with Renata that ChurnDate is recorded reliably enough to build on.
Next: scoping V1 honestly, a risk score, not a fix.
